findings.evidence: Panitia dapat melihat CTA Tugaskan pada event detail, tetapi /events/:id/assign-referees hanya menerima requireAdmin.
findings.current_behavior: CTA terlihat lalu direct navigation berakhir forbidden/redirect.
findings.expected_behavior: Action visibility dan route authorization memakai policy yang sama.
findings.impact: Workflow penugasan tampak tersedia tetapi tidak dapat diselesaikan.
findings.recommended_next_action: Tetapkan role owner assignment dan sembunyikan atau ubah CTA untuk role yang tidak berwenang.

findings.evidence: Export item menavigasi ke /database-export, sedangkan App.tsx mendaftarkan /export.
findings.expected_behavior: Nav target sama dengan route terdaftar.
findings.impact: Dead link pada menu admin provinsi.
findings.recommended_next_action: Reconcile path dan tambah route-navigation test.

findings.evidence: Cabang non-admin-provinsi menampilkan Event Approval /approvals, tetapi route hanya menerima admin_provinsi.
findings.current_behavior: admin_kab_kota melihat menu yang selalu forbidden.
findings.expected_behavior: Menu role-specific hanya menampilkan route yang dapat diakses.
findings.recommended_next_action: Hapus item dari role tersebut atau ubah target ke approval workflow yang benar.

findings.evidence: Assignment page hanya mengekspos refereesError; event, assignments, dan smartSuggestions tidak punya error branch. EventDetail tidak punya assignment error branch.
findings.current_behavior: Sebagian kegagalan tampak sebagai not-found, empty, atau no recommendation.
findings.expected_behavior: Setiap query punya error message, retry, dan state terpisah.
findings.impact: Operator dapat mengambil keputusan dari data yang gagal dimuat.
findings.recommended_next_action: Expose query errors dan retry/revalidation controls.

findings.evidence: Admin UI mengizinkan semua status termasuk cancelled/declined dan direct update hanya status; cancellation hook memiliki reason/cancelled_by/audit flow terpisah.
findings.current_behavior: Status dapat berubah tanpa reason, audit insertion, atau referee notification.
findings.expected_behavior: Transition mengikuti matrix dan memakai mutation contract per transition.
findings.impact: State bisnis dan audit trail dapat tidak konsisten.
findings.recommended_next_action: Constrain transitions dan route cancellation melalui contract canonical.

findings.evidence: Role change dan remove action memanggil mutation langsung; controls tidak disabled berdasarkan mutation pending.
findings.current_behavior: Repeated clicks dapat mengirim duplicate requests; failure hanya global toast.
findings.expected_behavior: Action-level pending/disabled state dan inline retry/rollback.
findings.impact: Duplicate mutation dan stale UI risk.
findings.recommended_next_action: Aggregate mutation busy state per row and revalidate after failure/success.

findings.evidence: Protected database export UI memiliki Seed Data tab yang menawarkan pembuatan 21 dummy users dan data testing.
findings.current_behavior: Admin UI production surface dapat memulai data dummy generation.
findings.expected_behavior: Seed tooling isolated from production application routes/environments.
findings.impact: Production contamination and unsafe destructive/data integrity risk.
findings.recommended_next_action: Remove from production build or hard-gate to non-production capability before UAT.

findings.evidence: upcoming/past query errors are not read; only loading flags are handled.
findings.current_behavior: Network/database failure renders normal empty state.
findings.expected_behavior: Error, retry, and offline/network state are explicit.
findings.impact: Referee cannot distinguish no assignments from failed retrieval.
findings.recommended_next_action: Expose query errors and retry control.

findings.evidence: Tables/cards and fixed mobile controls are implemented, but no repository evidence of viewport validation at required 320–1440px matrix exists.
findings.current_behavior: Responsive behavior is code-inferred, not verified; long labels/status controls may overflow.
findings.expected_behavior: Evidence-based viewport checks for required sizes.
findings.impact: Potential clipped controls and modal/table usability regressions.
findings.recommended_next_action: Run non-mutating browser viewport audit and record screenshots/issues.

findings.evidence: Several icon-only controls rely on title/class styling; tables lack explicit scope/caption evidence; loading/error announcements are plain content.
findings.current_behavior: Keyboard/screen-reader semantics are not consistently evidenced.
findings.expected_behavior: Accessible names, table headers/scope, live status announcements, and focus checks.
findings.impact: Assistive technology users may miss action/status changes.
findings.recommended_next_action: Run axe/keyboard audit and fix confirmed violations only.

findings.evidence: package.json has lint but no typecheck script; prior phase reports 66 lint errors and 11 warnings outside feature.
findings.current_behavior: Production quality gate cannot pass full lint baseline.
findings.expected_behavior: Clean or explicitly dispositioned lint gate plus reproducible typecheck command.
findings.impact: UAT signal is noisy and regressions can hide.
findings.recommended_next_action: Triage baseline lint findings and add documented typecheck script.
findings.dependency: Scope decision for legacy lint debt

findings.evidence: Most business hooks access Supabase directly and invalidate selected query keys; no unified repository/cache contract exists for all assignment surfaces.
findings.current_behavior: Admin/referee/event-detail views can have divergent cached shapes and refresh behavior.
findings.expected_behavior: Shared canonical repository/query keys and mutation invalidation contract.
findings.impact: Stale or inconsistent status after cross-surface mutation.
findings.recommended_next_action: Document and test query-key/revalidation matrix before refactor.

findings.evidence: Phase 8.1 route matrix reports 51 routes and omits /administration/event-assignments; current App.tsx has the added route and catch-all.
findings.current_behavior: Governance inventory is stale versus executable routing.
findings.expected_behavior: Route documentation regenerated after route additions.
findings.impact: Security/UX audits can miss protected surfaces.
findings.recommended_next_action: Regenerate route inventory as part of release gate.

findings.evidence: Design tokens exist, but raw page-level layout/status/table patterns and Inter/system font fallback are used broadly; no consolidated audit evidence proves variant consistency.
findings.current_behavior: Repeated UI patterns may drift across pages.
findings.expected_behavior: Shared primitives/variants for table, status, empty, error, and async states.
findings.recommended_next_action: Inventory confirmed duplicates and schedule focused design-system cleanup after UAT blockers.
